tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/lo glud cha tshang bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru badz+ra pā ṇi ye/lo glud rnying lugs kyi lag len ni zangs kyi ka ṭo ra la sogs pa'i snod gtsang mar zan gyi
༄༅/lo glud cha tshang bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru badz+ra pā ṇi ye/lo glud rnying lugs kyi lag len ni zangs kyi ka ṭo ra la sogs pa'i snod gtsang mar zan gyi

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ lo glud cha tshang bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra pā ṇi ye/ lo glud rnying lugs kyi lag len ni zangs kyi ka ṭo ra la sogs pa'i snod gtsang mar zan gyi ri rab gzugs bang rim bzhi pa/ shar dkar/ lho sngo/ nub dmar/ byang ser ba'am yang na mdog ma bsgyur yang rung / de'i rtser gza' mchog gi tsakli rab gnas can bzhugs pa'i phyogs bzhir bshos bu re re/ bang rim gnyis pa'i phyogs bzhir bshos bu gnyis gnyis te brgyad/ de rnams kyi mtha' gnyis su ngar mi re re ste brgyad/ bang rim 'og ma la phyogs bzhir bshos bu gnyis gnyis te brgyad/ ri rab kyi rtsa bar yang phyogs bzhir bshos bu gnyis gnyis te brgyad rnams mar rgyan ci mdzes bcas kyi mthar/ dar sna sogs gzhung nas bshad pa'i rdzas rnams kyis bskor rgyur/ dar sna rnams bang rim rtse mo'i gza' mchog gi sku rgyab dang zur bzhir mda' rgod sgro ma mde'u can nam smyug ma sogs shing gtsang ma'i rkang la btags/ gzhan yang gzhung las gang la gang dgos kyi tshogs bsham gsung ba ni bang rim bar pa dang 'og ma gnyis la bya/ ri dwags/ gcan gzan/ nya sbrul sogs rta drel mdzo g.yag bong bu ra lug sogs srog chags kyi tsakli sogs cha snyom du btsugs/ ri rab rtsa ba'i bshos bu'i mthar me brgyad bcas kyis bskor ba ras dkar sogs gzhi dkar po'i steng du bsham/ mdun dkar phud chang phud/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod bcas bshams la/ mkhan pa sogs spos gtsang mas bdug la bzhag rang gi mdun rdor dril nang mchod ḍā ma ru 'thor nas rnga rol grogs mang du yod na rkang gling sogs rol mo'i bye brag dang mdung mda' dar sogs spyan gzigs ci 'byor yang bya'o/ /'dir bdag bskyed phur chung bya ba'i dbang du btang na gong bsham kyi skabs sman rag gtor gsum dang / bsnyen phur yang bsham pa'i phyag len phal cher la ma bsham par bsam pas rung ba'ang 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis gdong dga' ba'i dris lan du gsung ngo /

/dngos gzhi la mchod pa byin brlabs nas/ kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol bar gyi bdag bskyed byas la gser skyems rgyas bsdus gang rung gtong ba ni phur bzlog nas 'byung ba ltar bdud rtsi byin brlabs nas bzung rgyas bsdus ci ltar yang / mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje yis/ /nyer dgongs byin brlabs dpal bskyed la/ /yul phyogs 'di'i mtshon 'jig rten du/ /sad ser btsa' than lo dgra'i tshogs/ /zhi zhing char chu mthun rkyen 'phel/ /mi phyugs longs spyod rgyas pa sogs/ /grub gnyis 'phel ba mdzad du gsol/ /zhes dang / gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /yul phyogs sogs༞ gser skyems gtsang mas tshim byas nas/ /yul phyogs sogs༞ /thams cad phud kyi tshim gyur nas/ /yul sogs tshig bsgyur ma gtogs/ dbyangs rol phyag len bzhin byas la rnga rol bzhag gong du bshams pa'i ri rab gzugs tsakli/ gtor ma glud rdzas sogs la dmigs nas/ sngags drug phyag drug rgya gar shes bsangs bzhin/ mgron rnams mnyes pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig ces pa'i rjes su/ rnga rol hod kyis blangs la chem brdung sgang dung / braṃ braṃ gcig gnyis gsum zhes dang / bdun brdung gsum che gcig kyai sangs rgyas nas༞ glud chen 'di bar 'dur shur gang rung / gang la bsngos pa sogs la tshig rol che gsum/ bdun brdung gsum che gcig chem brdung sgang dung bar la sngags brjod/ chem brdung rdzogs nas gsum brdeg len can/ kyai 'jigs byed sogs sh+lau ka gnyis la༞ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i dbyangs rol 'jug rgyur tshig rkang dang po la tshig dgu yod pas/ kyai 'jigs byed chen po la wā ya zhes pa khyad par tsam mo/ /phyag g.yas nas/ ki kang zhi bar mdzod bar 'dur shur gang rung / bcol lo la tshig rol gsum brdeg hūm̐ khyab mjug sogs sh+lau ka gcig la lha mchog nag po'i dbyangs rol ljang sngon nas 'dur shur gang rung / thog ser sogs la tshig rol gsum brdung chem brdung /

sngags brjod rkang gling / sbraṃ gcig gnyis zhes bzhag kyai sogs nas thog ser ki kang zhi bar mdzod bar/ nam gru ma'i dbyangs rol rkang gling / kyai gzhan yang nas span pa dang bar dpal thung gi dbyangs rol len med rkang gling / sku mdog nas bzhes la bar 'dur shur gang rung / thog ser sogs la rol mo rkang gling gong bzhin/ kyai nas zhi bar mdzod bar la shwa thung gi dbyangs rol rkang gling / kyai nam mkha'i sogs tshig rkang gnyis dang / de 'phros tshig rkang gnyis la de ltar tshar gcod ma'i dbyangs rol tshar gnyis rkang gling bcas/ bar snang nas 'dur shur gang rung thog ser sogs la tshig rol gsum brdung rkang gling dang / 'di man la rkang gling med/ hūm̐ srid pa'i nas che ba 'byin bar shar phyogs sgo srung ma'i dbyangs rol/ che ba'i yum gcig nas 'dur shur gang rung / bdag gi lo thog la tshig rol gsum brdung / kyai dpal ldan nas bzung rnga 'phar brdung / lo glud la tshig rol gsum brdung chem brdung / sngags brjod sbraṃ gcig gnyis zhes bzhag kyai gzhan yang ser ba'i nas bzung / ser ba'i bdag po thams cad la/ /lo glud mchod gtor 'di 'bul lo/ /thog ser ki kang zhi bar mdzod/ /bar thams cad kyi thog ser sogs la tshig gsum brdung re rigs 'gre/ mar me rnams sbar khyed la nas zhi bar mdzod bar la yang dag don du'i dbyangs rol len med sgang dung / kyai gzhi bdag nas rnga 'phar brdung byed mu bzhin/ 'khrug pa ma gtang zhig la tshig rol gsum brdung sgang dung / kyai klu rgyal sogs nas gong bzhin/ ma nor mdzod la tshig rol gsum brdung sgang dung / grangs gsog byed na khyed la mthun rdzas nas/ ma nor mdzod bar bdun sogs ci rigs la dbyangs dang sgang dung med/ rnga rol gzhan rnams 'dra/ grangs gsog med na nor mdzod rdzogs pa dang / ri rab can de sgo phyogs la kha bsgyur/ tsam lam 'then/ grangs gsog yod na rdzogs nas de bzhin byed/

yang zhing steng rang du gtang ba yin na byang shar phyogs la kha bsgyur/ tsam lam 'then/ rnga phyir brdung 'phar bcas kyi gshegs su gsol la tshig rol dgu brdung chem drag dung bcas byang shar la dkar phud/ chang phud rnams gtor/ gtor glud rnams kyang der gtang rag tsakli mda' sogs sdud dgos na tshur lam btum nas 'khyar/ skar mda' ltung dang sogs༞ 'jig rten bde zhing sogs/ yul phyogs kun tu sogs/ dmod bcol tshig bcad lhug gang shes rol mo sbugs la brjod la gsum brdeg len can sgang dung bcas rol mo bzhag ye shes lnga ldan sogs/ gong du bcom ldan rdo rje sogs kyi skabs spyan drangs pa rnams rang bzhin gyi ngang du bzhag gzhan gshegs bsdu ma dgos pas mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol gyi rjes su/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku ma ra sogs go bgo dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sogs bsngo smon/ skye med sogs bkra shis byas pas don tshang / yang phur chung gtor bsngo bskang ba sogs dang sbrel nas gtong na mchod gtor gang dgos drung 'di'i bcas rnams gong bzhin bshams la rdor glu bkra shis smon lam rdzogs nas/ gser skyems dang lo glud kyi gzhung gtang / gtor 'bul sogs so/ /yang bsangs dang sbrel nas gtong na sngags drug phyag drug bdag bskyed gser skyems rnams ni bsang gis des 'thus/ phrin 'chol rdzogs nas/ kyai sangs rgyas sogs la btsan 'jus las bcom rol mi dgos lo glud gtong / phywa 'gug chos bshad bsngo ba rnams te rgya gar shes bsangs la sbyar ba'i lugs yin pas rgyas bsdus gang byed kyang dpal sa skya'i rjes 'brangs rnams la lag len des chog cing / gzhan rang rang gi lugs ltar nyams su blang ngo / /zhes pa sa skya pa kun blos bris// ༈ /lo glud lag len dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༈ /bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba'i bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten gyi ser ba'i bdag po rnams la lo glud sbyin pa ni/

snod gtsang ma'i nang du: ri rab bang rim bzhi pa'i steng du: gza' mchog gi sku 'god: phyogs bzhi ru sring mo bzhi la bshos bu re re: bang rim gnyis pa la gza' brgyad la bshos bu: de'i phyi rim gyi bar rnams la ngar mi brgyad: de'i phyi rim bang rim gsum pa la rgyu skar nyer brgyad la 'brang rgyas nyer brgyad: de'i phyi rim bang rim bzhi la bshos bu brgyad dang : gang la gang dgos kyi tshogs bshams: spyan gzigs sna tshogs dang : dar sna: 'bru sna: sha sna: rin po che sna tshogs dkar phud chang phud rnams: gzhi dkar po'i steng du bsham la: sngags drug phyag drug gi byin gyis brlabs te: yul lha gzhi bdag sde brgyad dang bcas pa la gser skyems gtang la: ser ba'i bdag po la bden pa brdar ba 'di skad do: :kyai sangs rgyas rkang gnyis gtso ste bden pa'i mchog: chos nyid chags dang bral te bden pa'i mchog: dge 'dun mi byed 'dus te bden pa'i mchog: dkon mchog bka' la mi nyan gang yang med: ri rab sa la ma brten gang yang med: srid pa'i chu la mi thung gang yang med: nyi ma'i 'od kyi ma khyab gang yang med: zas dang skom la ma chags gang yang med: 'chi ba'i srog la mi 'dzem gang yang med: de bas dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa yi: mtho ba srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas: dma' ba na rag dmyal khams yan chod kyi: 'phags pa'i spyan gyi gzigs pa'i sems can rnams: bstan pa med pa'i mgron gyi tshul du gnyer: mchod sbyin gtor ma yas bzang glud chen 'di: gang la bsngos pa de bzhin thob par shog: sarba big+nan shan+tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā: ༈ kyai 'jigs byed chen po bka' gnyan mtha' tshig can: gza' bdud chen po ma rungs pa: khyab 'jug chen po kun du rgyu: 'jigs byed chen po sprul pa'i sku: rol mo/ lus po gcig la mgo bo dgu: mgo lus med pa mig gi gang : sku stod mi la sku smad sbrul:

sku mdog dud kha 'jigs pa la: rol mo: shur mas phyag g.yas kyin thang 'khor lo bsnams: g.yon pas chu srin zhags pa bsnams: lho nub mtshams nas sku bzhengs la: nub kyi phyogs nas lam du 'jug: zla ba'i rjes gcod shar nas rgyu: nyi mas rjes gcod nub nas rgyu: mtshan mo rgyus nas phyogs bzhi 'joms: nyin mo rgyus nas mtshams bzhi 'joms: bar snang khams nas rgyus tsam na: 'jig rten khams kun dngangs shing skrag: lto ba nyi zla khyud mi za: rlung rnams kun kyang 'phrug cing g.yo: sa g.yos chen po ma 'bebs cig: 'jigs byed chen po ma rung pa: zla dus tshes grangs kun gyi bdag: lha 'dre kun gyi bdag po khyed: lo glud mdos chen 'di bzhes la: dbyar gyi lo thog gnyan po la: ser ba'i sna 'dren ma mdzad cig: zla ba'i zer la ma chibs shig: nyi ma'i zer la ma 'gro cig: phyag na rdo rje'i zhabs drung du: rang rtags srog gi snying po phul: khas blangs dam bca' ma mda' cig: mthun pa'i lo glud 'di bzhes la: thog ser ki kang zhi bar mdzod: bcol lo stoms so thub pa srungs: khyab 'jug chen po bzhengs su gsol: ra hu la ni bzhengs su gsol: sprul pa chen po༞ dmag dpon chen po༞ shur mas ljang sngon chen po༞ bhai ro tsa na༞ bdud po nag po༞ rtsa ra ki ni༞ ro ti nag po༞ bya rog mgor rtsigs bzhengs su gsol: lo glud mdos chen 'di bzhes la: thog ser ki kang zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba shan+tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā: kye shar gyi stag srin zor ba gdong : lho'i baṃ srin dred kyi gdong : nub kyi skong srin ba glang gdong : byang gi 'brog srin chu srin gdong : sku mdog sna tshogs so sor bsten: g.yas g.yon bdud kyi zhal mtshon bsnams: lo glud mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: thog ser ki kang zhi bar mdzod: kyai gzhan yang 'khor du rtogs pa yi: shar gyi drang srong nyi ma dang : shar lho'i drang srong mig dmar dang :

lho'i drang srong phur pa dang : lho nub drang srong ra hu la: nub kyi drang srong zla ba dang : nub byang drang srong pa sangs dang : byang gi drang srong gza' lag dang : byang shar drang srong spen pa dang : sku mdog rang thad sna tshogs ston: rol mo/ shur mas phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams: lo glud mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: thog ser ki kang zhi bar mdzod: kyai rgyu skar rgyal po nyi shu brgyad: 'char ba dang ni nub pa dang : 'khor lo mtshon cha bzhin du rgyu: 'jig rten du ni zad 'phel byed: dus dang lo tshigs mtshams sbyor byed: smin drug la sogs 'khor bcas rnams: lo glud mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: thog ser ki kang zhi bar mdzod: rol mo chem brdung rkang gling zhi ba shan+tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā: kyai 'jig rten dregs pa ma rungs pa: lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas: gzhan yang ser ba'i bdag po kun: so sor glud dang gtor mas mchod: lo glud mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: thog ser ki kang zhi bar mdzod: kyai nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma: srid pa'i rgyal mo drag mo rgyal: mthing nag g.yu'i ral pa can: rgya mtsho'i gting nas me len ma: bar snang khams nas rlung 'byin ma: ri rab rtse nas hoṃ spor ma: nam mkha'i khams nas thog 'bebs ma: sku la sprin gyi gos gsol ma: gser dang g.yu'i 'khra bkod cing : phyag na gser gyi zor ba bsnams: thog ser bsrung ba'i dam can mthu mo che: dbyar gyi lo thog gnyan po la: thog ser bsrung ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ srid pa'i rgyal mo dbang mo che: 'byung ba lnga'i yum gcig mo: srid pa gsum la byo zlog mkhan: bskal pa snga phyi'i gzhi 'dzin ma: skye 'gro thams cad thugs las sprul: srid pa bdud rigs lus las sprul: klu rigs thams cad gzhal las sprul: 'brug rigs thams cad ngag las sprul: srid gsum 'di na che ba 'byin: rol mo/ /shur mas che ba'i rgyal mo yum gcig mo:

srid pa'i cho 'phrul mnga' mdzad ma: blangs thabs sprul pa'i nam mkha' la: thog dang ser ba'i sgo 'byed ma: dang po rang gi srid nas kyang ཿ dam can rgyun du ma gnod paraḥ skye ba'i lo 'bras ma sil bar: skye 'gro'i tshe srog ma gcod cig 'byung ba lnga po cha snyoms la: bdag gi lo thog smin par mdzod: kyai dpal ldan nag mo re ma ti: dus bzhi'i lha mo kun la shar: dpyid gsum rgyal mo byon pa'i tshe: sho ri dur khrod gnas myul ma: chu bo kun gyi gzhung 'byed ma: 'khyag pa'i mig tu sa 'debs ma: ming po rdo rjes las bcos na: sring mo rdo rjes las kyi shig: dbyar gyi rgyal mor byon pa'i tshe: bdag gi pri ti char 'bebs ma: 'brug dang thogs kyi sgra sgrog ma: sad dang ser ba'i sna 'dren ma: ming po rdo rjes las 'chol na: sring mo rdo rjes las kyi shig: ston gyi rgyal mor byon pa'i tshe: ma ra shin tu bstum ma ni: spang po de ni kha ser la: 'dzam gling 'bru'i bcud bsdus ma: ming po rdo rjes las 'chol na: sring mo rdo rjes las kyi shig: dgun gyi rgyal mor byon pa'i tshe: rgya mtsho'i gting nas me len ma: dpag tshad bcu nas dri bsnol ma: klu rnams kun la dang mo che: lo glud mchod gtor bzhes su gsol: oṃ du ru ma kha le pra ma ku ru ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa shan+tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā: kyai gzhan yang ser ba'i bdag po ni: srog bdag g.yu'i smin ma can: tshangs pa dung gi thor btsugs can: gnam lha dkar po 'khor dang bcas: spe dkar rgyal po skyes cig po: pho nya rgyal po shing bya can: mon bu pu tra la sogs pa'i: gtsug lag khang gi bsrung ma ste: bstan pa bsrung zhing chos 'khor skyongs: the'u rang stong sde'i rje bo ste: skyes mchog rdor legs 'khor dang bcas: gnam sa gnyis la dbang bsgyur ba'i: yaṃ shud dmar po srog gi bdag: btsan 'gong rgyal po 'khor bcas la: lo glud mchod gtor 'di 'bul gyis:

thog ser ki kang zhi bar mdzod: kyai rgyal po bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu: lha chen brgyad dang klu chen brgyad: gza' chen brgyad po 'khor bcas rnams: lo glud mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: thog ser ki kang zhi bar mdzod: kye gzhan yang ser ba'i bdag po ni: gshin rje chos rgyal man chad nas: 'chi bdag lha 'dre yan chad kyi: gshin rje'i rigs su rtogs rnams la: lo glud mchod gtor 'di 'bul lo: thog ser ki kang zhi bar mdzod: ma mo ye shes mkha' 'gro nas: grong rgyu sen mo yan chad kyi: ma mo'i rigs su rtogs༞ lo glud༞ thog ser༞ rgyal po gnam lha man chad nas: sras kun the rangs yan chad kyi: rgyal po'i rigs su rtogs pa༞ lo glud༞ thog ser༞ btsan 'gong yab shud dmar po nas: sha ba phreng thong yan chad kyi: btsan gyi rigs su༞ lo glud༞ thog ser༞ bdud rje mgon g.yag man chad nas: nag po rta thogs yan chad kyi: bdud kyi rigs su༞ lo glu༞ thog ser༞ bgegs rgyal byi na ya ga nas: yul 'dre chags 'dre yan chad kyi: 'gong po'i rigs su༞ lo glud༞ thog ser༞ mtha' yas 'jog po man chad nas: gdol pa nag po yan chad kyi: klu'i rigs༞ lo glud༞ thog ser༞ rmu rje btsan po man chad nas: dmu chu rol pa yan chad kyi: rmu'i rigs su༞ lo glud༞ thog ser༞ gza' bdud rog ti man chad nas: bza' phran rkun mo yan chad kyi: gza'i rigs su༞ lo glud mchod gtor 'di 'bul lo: thog ser ki kang zhi bar mdzod: kyai srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas: na rag dmyal khams yan chad kyi: srid pa'i dbang chen pho mo dang : len chags lha srin sde brgyad dang : ser ba'i bdag po thams cad la: lo glud mchod gtor 'di 'bul lo: thog ser ki kang zhi bar mdzod: khyed la mthun rdzas 'bul ba ni: ngar mi gzugs kyi glud du 'bul: mar me sems kyi glud du 'bul: sgra dang rol mo gsung gi glud: mthun pa'i rdzas dang yo byad rnams: lo thog gnyan po'i glud du 'bul:

glud mchog dam pa bzhes nas kyang : thog ser ki kang zhi bar mjod: kyai gzhi bdag yul gyi yul lha la: lo glud mchod rdzas 'bul ba ni: byol song mi nor sna tshogs dang : mkha' la lding dang sa la 'dzul: nags la rgyu dang rlan la 'grim: ri dwags lung 'grim la sogs pa: lo thog gnyan po'i glud du 'bul: mdor na srog chags grangs med dang : mthun pa'i dam rdzas sna tshogs dang : mdzes pa'i rgyan cha sna tshogs dang : spyan gzigs zhal zas sna tshogs dang : 'di 'dra'i lo glud ya mtshan can: rgyu ni rin chen lnga las byas: rkyen ni sngags dang phyag rgyas bskur: 'bras bu sku gsung thugs dang ldan: dang po 'bru lnga'i byin gyis brlabs: dgongs pa brgyud pa'i spang bstod do: longs spyod 'dod yon 'di rnams kun: khyab 'jug ming sring lnga po dang : srid pa'i dbang chen pho mo dang : gser glang nag po bye ma rog gcod dang : nag po bzlog med ma mo tsa mun tri: si ti sa la klu nag 'gyel pa dang : 'khor gyi rta dmag la sogs 'bum sde dang : dbang phyug chen po shrī ral pa can: gu lang nag po ka la yag sha dang : 'o yug dpon g.yog thams cad dang : lan chags lha srin sde brgyad dang : stag mo ma mo sman dang bcas: yul gyi lha klu gnyan po dang : the'u rang stong sde thams cad dang : bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad bcu dang : mgron du gyur pa thams cad dang : ser ba'i bdag po thams cad la: mthun pa'i rdzas glud 'di 'bul gyis: rnal 'byor bdag gis yul khams la: kyin thang thog ser ma btang cig: lo thog zas su ma za cig: nad dang dal yams ma btang zhig: phyugs nad blo zer ma btang zhig: glo bur ye 'drog ma btang zhig: bsam ngan sbyor rtsub ma mdzad cig: lo nyes 'khrug pa ma gtong cig: kyai klu rgyal nag po 'gyel pa dang : ba su dha ra rigs brgyad dang : dga' bo nye dga' la sogs dang : chu bdag ba ru klu chen brgyad: klu chen rigs bzhi 'khor bcas rnams:

lo glud mdos chen 'di bzhes la: lo thog smin pa mdzad du gsol: bsngos pa bdag gi ma nor ro: khas blangs khyed kyi ma nor mdzod: de nas mdos chen lam bstan te: kyai de ring yas su bsham pa'i glud chen 'di: med pa rnams kyi mi la rtsal: sra ba rnams ni brag la brkos: dkon pa rnams ni rgyu ru bshams: byang chub chen po'i don du gnyer: nam mkha' gang bar bshams nas 'bul: 'jig rten srid pa'i mthu chen rnams: rang rang gnas su song gzhud cig: so so'i gnas su song gzhud cig: ri gsum 'dus pa'i rtse la gzhud: ri gsum rtse la mi gshegs su: skye ser rlung po de na 'phyo: pha gi brag dmar ngos la gshegs: brag dmar ngos la mi gshegs su: bya rgyal rgod po de na lding : ma ka'i chu bo'i gzhung la gshegs: chu bo'i gzhung la mi gshegs su: nya sram 'grim pa de na yod: thams cad mgu zhing tshim gyur nas: rang rang gnas su gshegs su gsol: zhes mchod do: lo glud chen po rdzogs so: lo nad gso ba'i bdud rtsi: nad pa gso ba'i sman pa: sde brgyad bskong ba'i skor mdzod: thog ser bsrung ba'i gdam pa: dgra bgegs brdung ba'i tho ba: gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos: zhi ba glud kyi bsrungs thabs zab mo ྀatsha:: :: PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 10 kun dga' blo gros/ lo glud cha tshang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 9
